unresolved_candidate.description: The social-media platform scope is unresolved because the freelancer asks whether the content is for Instagram, Facebook, or both, and no client answer is supplied.
The relationship among the seven-to-nine brochures, portfolio items, social posts, and possible packaging into three PDF files is questioned but never authoritatively resolved.
Color-reference and deliverable-dimension questions are unanswered, so no concrete palette or size requirement can be established.

The freelancer states that the original agreed scope covered image design only, which conflicts with earlier client requests for pitch and social-media content; the resulting lifecycle impact on those content obligations is unresolved.
The parent portfolio, brochure, or other artifact containing image seven cannot be identified from the supplied evidence.
